plugins.description: Agent-teams orchestration skill — spawn, coordinate and shut down Claude Code agent teams with schema-validated tool signatures — plus the Codex Oracle MCP server: Codex (the strongest configured OpenAI model, reasoning pinned to max, live web search forced on with mandatory sources) as blind cross-model architect, reviewer and researcher. Anti-anchoring is built in: caller_hypothesis is refuted rather than confirmed, and a lint flags conclusions smuggled into scoping fields. Run tools watch, stop and continue Oracle runs (soft and hard steering) and survive MCP restarts; hooks gate plan mode and git push on a Codex review. Writers run as T3 child tasks that the lead starts, steers and stops; the skill says how.
